content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the failure to handle unaligned addresses in the `kasan_remove_zero_shadow` function. Specifically, when the shadow start and end addresses were not aligned to the page table size (PMD_SIZE, PUD_SIZE, etc.), the code did not correctly fall back to the next level of the page table hierarchy, resulting in unaligned page table entries (PTEs) not being removed. The condition checks were incorrectly structured, allowing the function to skip the necessary cleanup of unaligned memory regions. The patch corrects these conditions to ensure that unaligned addresses are properly handled.
